title: EAGLE: Entity-Aware Grounding with Layered Evidence for High-Resolution Image Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2611.27264v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) still struggle with fine-grained understanding of high-resolution images: attention heads vary in their reliability for grounding target entities and their attributes, while localized details are often disconnected from the broader scene context. We propose EAGLE (Entity-Aware Grounding with Layered Evidence for High-Resolution Image Understanding), a plug-in framework that jointly selects grounding signals and organizes hierarchical visual evidence. EAGLE employs a fine-grained dataset to screen visually-grounded attention heads, followed by entity-aware grounding to extract target-specific regions. It then integrates hierarchical evidence construction and question-guided routing to select optimal view combinations, feeding them into the frozen MLLM to enhance fine-grained visual understanding. translated_title: EAGLE：基于分层证据的实体感知定位方法用于高分辨率图像理解
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在高分辨率图像的细粒度理解方面仍然存在困难：注意力头在定位目标实体及其属性时的可靠性参差不齐，而局部细节往往与更广泛的场景上下文相脱节。我们提出了EAGLE（基于分层证据的实体感知定位高分辨率图像理解框架），这是一个联合选择定位信号并组织分层视觉证据的即插即用框架。EAGLE利用细粒度数据集筛选具有视觉定位能力的注意力头，随后通过实体感知定位提取目标特定区域。接着，它整合分层证据构建与问题引导的路由机制来选择最优视图组合，并将其输入冻结的多模态大语言模型中，以增强细粒度视觉理解。在Qwen2.5-VL-7B和InternVL3-8B上的实验表明，EAGLE能够持续提升模型性能表现。
tldr: EAGLE提出了一种即插即用框架，通过筛选可靠的视觉定位注意力头、实体感知区域提取，以及分层证据构建与问题引导的视图组合选择，在不改变冻结多模态大模型参数的情况下显著增强其对高分辨率图像的细粒度理解能力。
en_tdlr: EAGLE is a plug-in framework that enhances fine-grained high-resolution image understanding in frozen MLLMs by screening visually-grounded attention heads, extracting entity-aware target regions, and selecting optimal view combinations through hierarchical evidence construction and question-guided routing.
